mechanism_scan.where: llm extraction, verified quote, Appendix: Additional Details of Enhanced Mask Decoder

mechanism_scan.mechanism: DeBERTa_1.5B only: position projections shared with content projections

mechanism_scan.evidence: Second, a convolution layer is added aside the first Transformer layer to induce n-gram knowledge of sub-word encodings and their outputs are summed up before feeding to the next Transformer layer

output.notes: Described DeBERTa_base (primary) with separate W_{q,r}, W_{k,r} and no conv layer; 1.5B modifications listed under mechanisms. Vocab: base/large use the GPT-2/RoBERTa BPE vocabulary (size not given); 1.5B uses '128K' vocab, left not_stated because the exact integer is not written. Context length not stated (k=512 is max relative distance). Norm/placement/activation/biases inherited from BERT via the base-structure sentence; eps and GELU form not stated. Attention output projection is not explicit in the paper (inherited from BERT). Paper's ablation labels for C2P/P2C appear swapped relative to eq. dis-att.
